implementation.sharedComponents: DataWorkspace, TableViewport, MoneyCell, DateCell, TextCell, RecordStatus, RecordActions, RecordDetailDrawer; full-loaded collection search/filter/stable sort/page helpers.
implementation.masters: Subcontracts, Projects, Parties, GL accounts, Treasury accounts and Expense categories use summary tables with existing forms/actions in selected detail drawers.
implementation.subcontracts: Human Contract number, Contractor/Project/scope, authoritative Contract value/certified/advance outstanding/settlement values, status and details. Missing read-model metrics remain —; uncapped contracts identified. Existing certificates, payments, retention and metadata actions retained.
implementation.expenses: Separate sources/drafts/posted/entry views; structured source rows with preserved source references, yellow review warnings, one primary action plus accessible secondary disclosure. Posted register has counterparty/Project/funding fields and selected correction/reversal drawer. Removed page-only financial summary cards; explicit page scope and complete report export remain.
implementation.financialDocuments: Supplier payments, Contractor advances/certificates/payments and retention releases/payments use paged compact summaries and selected original financial details; confirmation controls and command inputs unchanged.
implementation.inventory: Materials/warehouses/documents/balances/movements use shared tables and appropriate selected drawers. Existing posting confirmation, valuation and GL logic unchanged.
implementation.people: Employee summary and single detail drawer; existing protected employment/Payroll screens retained. Attendance grid and existing Payroll register retain specialized structure with shared table viewport.
implementation.reportsAndFunding: Custody history, funding evidence/financial operations, certified openings/reconciliation, Party/Project/Treasury/Custody reports and Migration92 transaction report retain authoritative readers and existing specialized forms; shared table boundaries/columns applied.
implementation.platform: Eight existing administrative directories retain server search/pagination; compact Details plus secondary actions; technical IDs and full metadata remain in audit/detail views.
implementation.scrolling: Table-local horizontal scroll, page/modal vertical scrolling; fixed demonstrated posted Expense implicit-grid overflow. No global overflow hiding. Native focus-contained drawers yield to existing Inventory confirmation.
implementation.paging: Full-loaded client collections get deterministic pagination/filtered counts, exact BigInt sort and date/status/Project filters where applicable. Existing posted Expense, Platform and Migration92 server pagination and full exports are preserved; no invented global totals.
